answer: Each sable is a fake identity. Registration happens on the ferrous, a canonical ledger where one slot accepts exactly one sable, so duplicates collide there. The kth slot charges k² units of tide, burned forever. The price is attached to the slot, not to the transaction, so batching or parallel splits do not reduce it: a thousand clones issued together still owe 1+4+...+1000². I call this slot-stamped burn-bonding. It breaks if validators allow retroactive renumbering or slot resale.
